The mushroom behind the name

What is Ganoderma?

Ganoderma lucidum, better known as reishi, is a glossy, red-capped mushroom that grows on wood. The name is Greek and Latin: ganos means brightness, derma means skin, and lucidum means shining. It describes the lacquered cap you see in our logo.

灵芝Língzhī, the Chinese name
灵 língspirit, divine
芝 zhīmushroom, sacred herb

Where the name Lingzhi comes from

Lingzhi is the Chinese name for this mushroom, often translated as the “spirit mushroom”. In Chinese culture it has long been a symbol of good fortune and long life. We took the name because we blend it with farm-grown African coffee, so the cup carries something old and something new.

We talk about taste and tradition only. Lingzhi coffee is not a medicine and isn’t meant to diagnose, treat or cure any condition.

About Lingzhi

Revitalising Africa’s coffee heritage, from seed to cup. For Africa, by Africa.

Who we are

Lingzhi Global Nigeria Limited is a knowledge-driven company in coffee, chocolate and tea, with a focus on wellness and export.

Our mission

To revitalise Africa’s coffee heritage while promoting sustainable growth, leadership and wellness across the continent and beyond.

Our founder

Blessing Nanman Tangtur, CEO, founded Lingzhi Global in 2023 after nearly a decade in the industry. She brings a background in education and international coffee certifications.

Questions

How long does delivery take?

Lagos and Abuja usually 1–3 working days. Other states 3–6 working days.

How do I pay?

You can pay securely at checkout with Paystack (card, bank transfer, or USSD). This store currently uses a demo Paystack flow so you can preview the experience.

How do I make it iced?

Stir one sachet into a splash of hot water, then pour over ice. Add milk if you like.

Do you offer gifts or bulk orders?

Yes. Message us on WhatsApp for gift boxes, offices and events.
